status: Unvalued template: supply sourced inputs before making a business case

discount.source: Required case input: Illustrative required return, not a market quote.

historyYears.source: Required case input: Explicit observation exposure for annualisation; confirm against the real history coverage.

downtimeValue.source: Required case input: Illustrative contribution lost; simultaneous asset downtime may overlap. Not plant outage hours.

avoidMaintenance.source: Required case input: Avoidable share of recorded maintenance cost; excludes the downtime lever.

avoidDowntime.source: Required case input: Avoidable share of recorded asset downtime.

oneOff.source: Required case input: Shared implementation cost at year zero.

perUnit.source: Required case input: Implementation cost for each included equipment set.

units.source: Required case input: Demonstration rollout covers seven equipment sets.

contingency.source: Required case input: Applied to shared and per-set implementation costs.

annualRunning.source: Required case input: Support and hosting at constant prices.

otherBenefit.source: Required case input: No additional monetised lever is assumed.

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.source: SYNTHETIC: half the base benefit, 25% higher costs.
